main_claim: At zero quadratic slope-kernel curvature d_U=0, a bounded density for the residual linear slope beta(R) yields an integrated L^rho frequency budget. At rho=4, ||p_Q||_infinity <= 4.83295511233 (M_U M_V)^(2/5)|det B|^(-2/5)L_beta^(1/5), with continuous C0 density. For an orthonormal original-product two-dimensional bank, L_beta <= 1/(sqrt(2)H_U), H_U=||K w_U||, so every H_U>0 branch is paid.
exact_kernel_identity: d_U=0 implies K w_U=(theta_U,h_U,0); hence H_U=0 implies K w_U=0
dual_null_refinement: If both orientations fail exactly and (p,q)!=(0,0), w_U,w_V are independent null vectors and rank K<=3; under a three-large-eigenvalue packet hypothesis rank K=3. If p=q=0, exact failure forces a=0 and the scalar coordinate decouples, leaving a pure four-dimensional two-bank core.
